# Es Venture

> Creative digital studio for entrepreneurs. Brands, websites and prototypes, shaped around what makes each business worth noticing.

I make brands, websites and prototypes for entrepreneurs. Every project starts from what makes your business different from the rest. Selected work includes Dennis Gerrits, Studio Ingrid de Reuver and HAP.

- [HAP case](/work/hap): UX and prototype case story.
